project_type: TensorFlow 2.10 research codebase (groupwise 3D brain MRI registration, cascade levels 4 -> 2 -> 1); Python scripts + bash SLURM scripts; no build step
language: Python (must parse as Python 3.8: cluster container py3.8.10, TF 2.10, numpy 1.21.1, scipy 1.4.1); bash for slurm/
build_system: none (pure Python). Local envs in WSL Ubuntu: conda env tf_gpu (TF 2.10, py3.9, needs the GPU visible; crashes CPU-only) for TF tests; bgr_preproc38 (py3.8, no TF) for the syntax check and TF-free tests
test_framework: unittest. Every TF test module imports tests.tf_setup FIRST (sets the 6000 MB GPU limit). TF-free modules (tests.test_slurm_scripts, test_memory_model, ...) must not import TF.
test_command: Single module (WSL, worktree path, tf_gpu): cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.worktrees/fine-grid-integration && source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate tf_gpu && export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 && python -m unittest tests.test_fine_grid_integration -v   (TF-free: conda activate bgr_preproc38 && python -m unittest tests.test_slurm_scripts -v). Full suite (~3 h+, run in background and poll): wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.worktrees/fine-grid-integration/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh
verification_instructions: 1) Run the touched modules' tests in WSL (commands above; write a small bash script file into the worktree's .agents/tasks/fine-grid-integration/ and run it with wsl -d Ubuntu bash <path> to avoid PowerShell quoting problems; see .kiro/skills/shell-and-remote-jobs/SKILL.md in the MAIN checkout d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad\.kiro\skills\shell-and-remote-jobs\SKILL.md, read-only). 2) Goldens must stay 0 diff: tests.test_predict_tta_golden, tests.test_trainer (TestLinearGolden / LNCC deform golden). 3) The full suite tests/run_tests_wsl.sh must end with 'suite status: 0' (part 1 is the py3.8 syntax check + bash -n of slurm scripts + TF-free tests).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Golden fixtures tests/fixtures/predict_tta_off_golden.json, m7_linear_golden.json, lncc_deform_golden.json must NOT be rewritten (never set BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1).
environment_constraints: Work ONLY in the worktree d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad\.worktrees\fine-grid-integration (git -C <worktree>); another agent edits the main checkout: never touch, stash, reset or checkout anything there. Never push. Never submit SLURM jobs, never use Glacier/SSH. Never raise BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB above 6000. Local GPU is an 8 GB GTX 1080: level-1 trainer deform steps are traced, not executed (existing ChainCase convention); level-1 chain forwards at N 2 with tiny configs are fine. Windows PowerShell 5.1 host: strip CRLF issues in .sh files (slurm scripts must be LF, ASCII).
contribution_requirements: Default behaviour bit-identical (native path verbatim; no default of any existing script changes; existing goldens 0 diff). No changes to losses, label sets, model architecture. Py3.8 syntax. Commit locally on branch fine-grid-integration with descriptive messages; do not commit other agents' files.
key_patterns: Frozen stages: models/cascade.py FrozenStage / FrozenChain (float32, training=False, tf.stop_gradient, called outside the tape); factories from_checkpoint / from_model / from_config / from_models. Skip ops only under name scope 'cascade_skip' and only built when a skip tensor is passed. diffeo conventions in the models/diffeo.py docstring (voxel units per level, compose(u_a,u_b) = phi_a o phi_b, upsample_displacement = 2*trilinear x2, compose_cascade order). Config provenance: main.py writes config.json args (A.args_to_dict) + extra blocks (cascade record). Inference: inference/loader.py LoadedModel, inference/runner.py StreamedRunner/UnchunkedRunner with separate default and level-plan (_sel) paths; new behaviour goes in NEW methods so default paths stay untouched. SLURM scripts: env -> flag only when set; BGR_DRY_RUN=1 prints MAIN/CHECK lines and exits 0; tests in tests/test_slurm_scripts.py run them with stub singularity.
directory_structure: models/ (network, diffeo math, cascade frozen stages), runtime/ (args, Trainer in run.py, checkpoint, eval_run), main.py (training entry), inference/ + predict.py (prediction engine: loader, streamed/unchunked runners, TTA, CLI), slurm/ (cluster scripts), scripts/ (helpers), tests/ (unittest; tests/gpu = cluster-only tools), .agents/tasks/<task>/ (plans, reports)
